decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is close to the firm's established skincare knowledge and has dedicated website presentation, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it, making a drop very unlikely.
The hyaluronic acid serum builds on existing formulation know-how, allowing the firm to assimilate market feedback and improve the product, so it is likely to be kept.
The cleansing milk is also within the firm's core natural skincare competence, enabling learning and improvement, so it is likely to remain on the market.
